title: Cartesian higher image chart system construction
statement: For schemes X,S, f:X→S, a small category I, D:I→Over S and i∈I, define the chart diagram Over i→Over(X×S D(i)) as Over.post of the underlying scheme diagram followed by pullback along the projection X×S D(i)→D(i). For any cone c over D, define its chart cone by the same pullback functor applied to the over-post cone. Both are actual functor/cone constructions and require no limit or cofilteredness assumption.

def cartesianChartDiagram
    {S X : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S)
    {I : Type u} [SmallCategory I] (D : I ⥤ Over S) (i : I) :
    Over i ⥤ Over (pullback f (D.obj i).hom)
